name: MEzz
source:
Defunct Medical Equipment Made Manifest

A long-abandoned piece of medical equipment, MEzz was initially created with the purpose of providing free care. Of course, in the right(?) hands she can do just the opposite.

[Translated from the official website by [url=https://x.com/DistantValhalla/status/1727446496906276944]Steiner[/url]]
